annotations.title: Hyrox Post-Race Split & Station Variance Autopsy

description: Diagnose completed or simulated Hyrox race results by comparing actual `8x1 km` run splits and 8 functional station times against empirical compromised pacing targets and P25–P75 station variance benchmarks. Stateless public calculator (no auth required). Use post-race or post-sim when actual run or station splits exist; to project pre-race target splits from a 5K time alone, use `hyrox_splits` or `hyrox_pace` instead.

actual_finish_time.description: Optional official chip finish time as H:MM:SS.

run_times.description: Optional 8 actual 1 km Hyrox run lap splits in race order as MM:SS strings.

standalone_5k_time.description: Athlete's standalone open 5 km run time as MM:SS (e.g. '22:30') anchoring expected pace.

station_times.description: Optional actual station split times (MM:SS) keyed by station slug (`skierg`, `sled_push`, `sled_pull`, `burpees`, `row`, `farmers_carry`, `lunges`, `wall_balls`).

total_run_time.description: Optional cumulative 8 km run split total as MM:SS or H:MM:SS when individual laps are unavailable.

name: hyrox_autopsy

actual_avg_run_pace.description: Observed mean 1 km Hyrox run pace (null when neither `run_times` nor `total_run_time` was supplied).

app_url.description: Deep link to inspect this calculation interactively in STRUGGL.

connect_url.description: URL to connect a stateful STRUGGL athlete ledger via OAuth 2.1 or token.

laps_analysis.description: Per-lap delta vs expected station-fatigued target pace.

methodology.description: Peer-reviewed sports-science equation and STRUGGL pillar provenance.

onboarding.description: OAuth 2.1 connector metadata explaining what longitudinal state unlocking adds.

recommendations.description: Targeted training fixes for the biggest run/station time leaks.

station_bottlenecks.description: Station-by-station variance diagnosis vs P25–P75 benchmarks.

theoretical_hyrox_pace.description: Expected compromised Hyrox run pace from 5K fitness.

time_lost_compromised_running_formatted.description: Formatted time delta on compromised running.

time_lost_compromised_running_s.description: Seconds lost (or gained) on the runs vs expected compromised pace.
